description:
Stunning Two Bedroom Penthouse | Three Private Balconies | Two Secure Parking Spaces

Please note: The apartment will be let unfurnished. The furniture shown in the photographs is for presentation purposes only and will not form part of the tenancy.

A beautifully presented and exceptionally private two bedroom, two bathroom penthouse in Knockmaree, Chapelizod, offering generous living space, three private balconies, spectacular views and two secure underground parking spaces.
This is a genuinely distinctive apartment, combining the privacy and proportions of penthouse living with the convenience of being just minutes from Dublin City Centre.
The spacious open plan living and dining area is bright and beautifully proportioned, with direct access to the outdoor terraces and extensive views across Dublin. The three private balconies provide an unusual amount of outdoor space for a city apartment and create a wonderful extension of the living accommodation.
The property comprises two generous double bedrooms, two bathrooms and a stylish kitchen with integrated appliances. The principal bathroom features a beautiful freestanding copper bath, creating a striking focal point within the apartment.
Finished to a high standard throughout, the apartment benefits from excellent natural light, generous living accommodation, a BER A3 rating and secure underground parking for two cars.
Located in the established Knockmaree development, the apartment is approximately three minutes' walk from Chapelizod Village, with its cafés, restaurants, local shops and everyday amenities.
Phoenix Park is also close by, while Dublin City Centre, Kilmainham and surrounding areas are easily accessible by road and public transport. The location also provides convenient access to the N4 and M50.
For those looking for something beyond a standard city apartment, this penthouse offers a rare combination of space, privacy, outdoor living, parking and views.
Available immediately.
